calls.statement:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2026-06-01' AS start_date, DATE '2026-06-28' AS end_date
),
period_days AS (
    SELECT d.calendar_date FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date AND d.is_trading_day
),
trading_days AS (
    SELECT cs.store_id, COUNT(*) AS trading_days
    FROM dim_store cs
    CROSS JOIN period_days pd
    WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.store_id < 900
      AND (cs.open_date IS NULL OR cs.open_date <= pd.calendar_date)
      AND (cs.close_date IS NULL OR cs.close_date >= pd.calendar_date)
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                      WHERE c.store_id = cs.store_id AND pd.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date)
    GROUP BY 1
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
store_sales AS (
    SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
    GROUP BY 1
),
ctl AS (
    SELECT r.store_id, SUM(r.net_sales) AS ctl_net FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE r.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date AND r.store_id < 900 GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.net_sales / td.trading_days DESC) AS rank, cs.store_id, cs.store_name, cs.format,
       td.trading_days, ss.net_sales, ROUND(ss.net_sales / td.trading_days, 0) AS per_day, ctl.ctl_net, ss.net_sales - ctl.ctl_net AS diff
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN trading_days td ON td.store_id = ss.store_id
JOIN dim_store cs    ON cs.store_id = ss.store_id AND cs.is_current
LEFT JOIN ctl ON ctl.store_id = ss.store_id
ORDER BY rank

SELECT (SELECT count(DISTINCT store_id) FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id<900) AS current_stores,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28') AS lines,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28') AS distinct_lines,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS dup_receipt_lines,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28') AS returns,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT return_line_id) FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28') AS distinct_returns,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=125 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-15' AND DATE '2026-06-28') AS kuopio_closed_sales,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' AND f.sale_date IN (DATE '2026-06-19', DATE '2026-06-20') AND s.store_id<900) AS holiday_sales,
 (SELECT max(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line) AS max_sale

SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.net_sales / td.trading_days DESC) AS rank, cs.store_id, cs.store_name,
       td.trading_days, ss.net_sales, ROUND(ss.net_sales / td.trading_days, 2) AS net_sales_per_trading_day
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN trading_days td ON td.store_id = ss.store_id
JOIN dim_store cs    ON cs.store_id = ss.store_id AND cs.is_current
ORDER BY rank
